item.title: Change In Primary Voting Rules Leads To Confusion In 2 Texas Counties As Voters Are Turned Away

item.title: Governments Scramble To Bring Citizens Home During Travel Chaos Caused By Iran War
item.description: By The Associated Press PARIS (AP) — Governments across the world scrambled to organize the return of their citizens from the Middle East on Wednesday as travel across the region remained heavily disrupted by the widening Iran war. item.title: Business Moving Stats
item.description: It’s not just families that are moving to Texas in record numbers, so are businesses. Economist Vance Ginn credits the low cost of living and favorable corporate taxes. Between 2018 and 2024, a total of 212 company headquarters moved to Texas. On the flip side, 276 companies have left California.

item.title: Prayer In School
item.description: Around one-dozen Texas school districts have voted to set aside time each day for students and staff to pray. And, while that’s a small number, experts say it only tells part of the story. Mary Elizabeth Castle with Texas Values says that some districts that voted no did so because they already have prayer time in clubs. The deadline to approve the new plan was March 1st.
